newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia ferry sinks, one dies - agency.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia ferry sinks, one dies - agency.

text.p: A three-year-old boy died after a ferry carrying more than 80 people sank near Indonesia's Sumatra island on Saturday, the official Antara news agency reported on Sunday.
Antara said the ferry M.V. Santosa, which had 85 registered passengers, sank on its way from Batam island to the nearby Bintan island on Saturday afternoon, off Sumatra island in western Indonesia.
"A boy, named Andi, has died in the accident," a navy official was quoted as saying.
Search and rescue officials contacted by the agency said they had rescued 91 passengers from the ferry and that some of them had been sent to hospital.
The agency said the cause of the accident was still being investigated, but quoted sources as saying that water started to enter the ferry about 20 minutes after it left Batam.
The agency gave no further details. Rescue officials in Batam could not be reached for comment on Sunday.
